## History

Fiske worked as a travelling evangelist at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) five years ago. During this time, he pretended to be a [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) while actually remaining a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist).
